Context: 5. Family means.-

11. Gratuity in case of missing employee.Where a Government servant is missing, retirement gratuity will be paid to the family after lodging FIR and applying to the Head of Office after 6 months, observing the formalities. - Rule 33.
12. Recovery of Government dues.Government dues as ascertained and assessed by the Head of Office outstanding can be adjusted against the amount of the retirement gratuity. - Rule 45.
